blockers.detail: Approved target-network execution and consensus sources are not provisioned.
Indexer and Explorer production-equivalent endpoint inventories are placeholders/unprovisioned.
Canonical Registry, consensus, block/transaction/receipt/log and producer witnesses cannot be collected without B1/B2.
Restart/resume, outage, stale/provider failure, bounded reorg, finalized-conflict and rebuild exercises cannot be production-equivalent without a deployed stack.
